name: naia-enter-banishes-deep-spell-tags-it-and-rest-to-graveyard
notes: Naia, Diviner of Fortunes (jdmthh88rx): the third revealed card is a Spell (Fairy Whispers); it is banished and tagged NAIA_BANISHED, the other two go to the graveyard.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] On Enter: Reveal the top three cards from your deck. Banish one of those cards and put the rest into your graveyard. If the banished card is a Spell card, you may activate it as long as you control CARDNAME.
